Corrected this round: `install({time})` actually starts a clock that FLOWS in real time until `pauseAt()` is called, so the auto-retrying `toHaveText` assertions correctly wait out hydration + the first interval tick syncing to the fake clock — this is the right pattern, not a bug. Fixed/verified in round 3: independently re-ran `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/home.spec.ts --reporter=list` myself (not just reading evidence) — 27 passed, exit 0, both TC ID-24/ID-39 and TC ID-41/ID-42 green; cross-checked against 3 additional recorded consecutive green runs in evidence/raw-green-runs.json.
